# yoinker

> An Agent Skill for explaining unfamiliar tools and ideas, testing whether their mechanisms transfer
> to a specific situation, and deciding what to borrow, try, track, or reject.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Product story, installation path, example prompts, boundaries, and status.
- [skills/yoinker/SKILL.md](skills/yoinker/SKILL.md): Canonical skill instructions and mode router.
- [skills/yoinker/references/assess-an-artifact.md](skills/yoinker/references/assess-an-artifact.md):
  Evidence-to-local-transfer procedure for a specific candidate.
- [skills/yoinker/references/answer-an-open-question.md](skills/yoinker/references/answer-an-open-question.md):
  Source-grounded explanation and comparison procedure.
- [skills/yoinker/templates/decision-brief.md](skills/yoinker/templates/decision-brief.md): Optional
  inspectable decision artifact.
- [evaluation/protocol.md](evaluation/protocol.md): Proposed paired behavioral evaluation and promotion
  gate.
- [.codex-plugin/plugin.json](.codex-plugin/plugin.json): Codex plugin metadata.
- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Claude Code plugin metadata.

## Project documents

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution and evidence expectations.
- [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md): Versioning, behavioral gate, distribution review, and release checklist.
